records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net sales were $1.81 billion, an increase of 46.9% from the $1.23 billion in 2020;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our net sales increased approximately $575.9 million, or 46.9%, for the twelve months ended December 31, 2021, compared to the prior year, due primarily to our content expansion initiatives, improvements in product mix, overall strong demand for our products (especially in comparison to the negative effect of Covid-19 in 2020), and record revenue in the automotive, industrial, communication and consumer end-user markets.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cost of goods sold is also affected by inventory obsolescence if our inventory management is not efficient.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Gross margin improved 200 basis points to 37.1% from 35.1% in 2020;

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income increased 105.4% to $276.0 million, or 15.3% of net sales, compared to $134.3 million, or 10.9% of net sales, in 2020;
